basis:
Independent arithmetic: 65 − 63.5 = 1.5 kg; + 0.4 L intake = 1.9 L net loss. 1.9 L over 1 hour = 1.9 L/h. 1.5/65 × 100 = 2.3077…, rounded to 2.31%, which is above the 2% threshold.

Steps: ["Net loss = 65 − 63.5 + 0.4 = 1.9 L.", "Sweat rate = 1.9 ÷ (60 / 60) = 1.9 L/h.", "Body mass loss = (65 − 63.5) ÷ 65 × 100 = 2.3077…%, rounded to 2.31%.", "2.31% is above 2%, so aboveTwoPercent is true."]
Notes: The 2% flag is a screening prompt to review the fluid plan, not a diagnosis. Heavy sweating with weakness, dizziness, nausea or headache should stop the session; confusion, slurred speech, very high temperature or loss of consciousness is an emergency.
